why: The nightly card's run log: one document per GitHub run of the nightly workflow, under GitHub's own run id and upserted every hour the card reads the runs, so a run read twice is one document; and one document per slot of the Function, kind firing, under the slot's hour, when Azure Monitor has the slot's five-minute counts. Partitioned on the UTC day of the run or the slot, and written by the SQL site alone. The day, the moment and the kind are indexed and nothing else, because the card asks for the last thirty days of runs and nothing else. Documents expire a year after they are written, so a season of nights can be looked back on and nothing has to run to delete one (ADR: The Nightly Function on the Admin tab).
